about.title: Understanding Persian poetry, one verse at a time
about.p1: Shaareh is a website for Persian poetry and literature. It explores and interprets selected poems and literary books; each commentary is a video shown next to the verses of the poem it discusses.
about.p2: Tapping a verse takes the video straight to the part where that verse appears on screen and its commentary begins, so you can go directly to the line you are curious about, or follow a whole ghazal verse by verse.
about.p3: Poem texts come from Ganjoor, and the videos are published on Aparat.

studio.title: Timing the verses
studio.lead: Open the commentary video, bring in the poem, and record the moment each verse's commentary begins. The result is a commentary ready for the site's list.
studio.localHelper: Time with a file of the same video (optional)
studio.localHelperHint: The Aparat player does not share its playback time with the site. If you have a file of the same video, open it to record times with the T key; the result still points to Aparat.
studio.poemHint: One verse per line; separate the two hemistichs with " / ". A line without a separator is kept as a single line (e.g. prose from the Golestan).
studio.timingHint: Play the video and, whenever the commentary of the highlighted verse begins, press T or the "Record" button. To fix one, tap its row number or type the time.
studio.timingEmpty: No verses yet — bring in the poem text in step 2.
